description: This file contains unit tests for the RuntimeLocator functionality, which resolves and verifies the runtime environment, specifically for Node.js versions, by executing scripts and parsing their output. It tests different scenarios including successful resolution, boundary checks, parsing errors, and failure descriptions.

methods.name: makeTempExecutable
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory and file, writes the provided contents to it, sets executable permissions, and returns the file URL.

methods.name: `resolve succeeds with valid node`
methods.description: Test that verification of a valid Node.js executable returns a success result with the correct version.

methods.name: `resolve fails on boundary below minimum`
methods.description: Test that a Node.js version below the minimum supported version results in an unsupported error.

methods.name: `resolve fails when too old`
methods.description: Test that an older Node.js version results in an unsupported error.

methods.name: `resolve fails when version unparsable`
methods.description: Test that an unparseable version string results in a versionParse error.

methods.name: `describe failure includes paths`
methods.description: Test that failure messages correctly include associated paths and searched paths.

methods.name: runtime version parses with leading V and metadata
methods.description: Test the parsing of version strings with prefixes and additional metadata, ensuring correct version extraction or nil for invalid strings.
